audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Missing n! in advertised toric Ruelle invariant; False universal automorphism bound and endpoint gauge identity; Wrong coefficient in complex-to-real trace identity
limitations: Limits: Journal version unavailable; no version equivalence asserted.
Limits: External ergodic, capacity, lower-index foundations and convex smoothing not fully reproved.
Limits: No counterexample to qualitative nonconvex dynamically convex domains claimed.
Limits: Geometric application uses finite invariant measures and n>=2; one-dimensional index conventions not certified.
Limits: Exact frozen arXiv:2205.00935v1,2 May2022 only; publisher-version equivalence is not asserted.
Limits: Focused verification of six existing Problems; finite-measure ergodic theory, cited capacity results, contact foundations and full concave smoothing were not independently reconstructed.
Limits: No counterexample to the qualitative existence of dynamically convex nonsymplectically convex domains; no unjustified global smoothness at the origin/skeleton is used.

Limits: Report pages1-4 are reused only through exact identical page-image hashes tied to prior actual viewing. Changed page5 was actually viewed. Scientific decision remains pending and human reviews empty.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
